Container.Name: scopearr
Container.Overview: Filter your Radarr and Sonarr media library using existing filenames and API metadata. Local SQLite cache. No media mounts required. Optional: mount your media root read-write to remove or edit tracks with MKVToolNix (downloaded into Appdata). One local admin login. Configure API connections in the WebUI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: WebUI port on the dedicated container IP.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Local SSD/pool path. No SMB/NFS. Owner must match UID/GID in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: HTTPS proxy
Config.Description: Set true only when the browser accesses this app through HTTPS.

Config.Name: Go memory target
Config.Description: Soft Go memory target, clamped to one quarter of the container memory limit to retain headroom.

Config.Name: Go CPU parallelism
Config.Description: Limit Go execution threads to two by default.

Config.Name: Media root (optional, MKVToolNix)
Config.Description: Only for track editing. Mount the root that contains all media shares, e.g. /mnt/user/ – shares such as 'movies' and 'shows' then appear as /media/movies and /media/shows. Map 'Arr path => /media/...' under Settings → Services → MKVToolNix. Read-write access is granted to everything below this path; Scopearr only writes inside mapped folders. Allow UID 99/GID 100 to write. Never mount media under /data (Appdata).

Config.Name: Mux working directory (optional)
Config.Description: Optional separate directory for temporary MKVToolNix output, e.g. a cache/SSD folder. Leave empty to mux next to the media file (default). Needs free space for the largest output file.

Config.Name: Unraid disks (optional, disk placement)
Config.Description: Physical Unraid disks and pools. Scanning needs read access only; moving and mux output on the original disk require write access for UID 99/GID 100. Scopearr writes only in mapped media folders on physical disks/pools, never in /mnt/user, /mnt/disks or /mnt/remotes. Existing containers: Add another Path.

Config.Name: Unraid state (optional, read-only)
Config.Description: Optional read-only Unraid status directory. Allows disk placement to wait while mover or parity operations are running. Never mount the Docker socket.
